title: Acceptance by Other Desks and Fee Credits under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services
content:
# Acceptance by Other Desks and Fee Credits, by Service

For each service of Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services, whether the protection desk accepts that service as the appraisal it requires, whether the upgrade desk accepts it as the valuation it requires, whether the fee is credited when the piece is traded up at the chain, and whether the fee is credited when a commission is placed on the back of the report are as follows.

| Service | Accepted by the protection desk as the appraisal it requires | Accepted by the upgrade desk as the valuation it requires | Fee credited when the piece is traded up at the chain | Fee credited when a commission is placed on the back of the report |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | No | No | No | No |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | No | Yes | No | No |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |

## Reading notes

- The protection desk accepts three services as the appraisal it requires: the Insurance Replacement Appraisal, the Certified Gemological Laboratory Report and the Collection Portfolio Appraisal.
- The upgrade desk accepts every written service as the valuation it requires, and does not accept the Verbal Counter Estimate.
- The fee is credited against a trade-up at three services: the Insurance Replacement Appraisal, the Fair Market Value Appraisal and the Certified Gemological Laboratory Report.
- The fee is credited against a commission at four services: the Insurance Replacement Appraisal, the Fair Market Value Appraisal, the Certified Gemological Laboratory Report and the Collection Portfolio Appraisal. The Estate and Probate Appraisal fee is credited against neither.
- The Collection Portfolio Appraisal is the one service whose fee is credited against a commission but not against a trade-up.
